label: LPBF workflow
description: One material and process vector; explicit simulation and screening scope.

label: Bayesian Optimization
description: Autonomous closed-loop search for optimal parameters balancing productivity and defect risk.

label: Microstructure Lab
description: Screening-field solidification G/R (Python lpbf_thermal_solver, Rosenthal/ET/Goldak conduction fields) with Hunt G/R morphology, Hunt–Lu PDAS and Kirkwood SDAS; status-labelled screening, not in-situ tracking, not validated

label: EBSD/CT Validation
description: Phase 10: Experimental EBSD/CT metric comparison and Traceability Pipeline.

label: Toolpath & Kinematics
description: Phase 12: Galvanometer mirror acceleration, G-Code/CLI delays and local thermal hotspot detection.

label: Fatigue & Fracture Lab
description: Phase 13: Kitagawa-Takahashi diagrams, El-Haddad small defect limits and Paris crack propagation.

label: Defect Mitigation
description: Phase 15: Inverse kinematic power compensation and 67° scan rotation for defect suppression.

label: Keyhole Ray Tracing
description: Seeded Monte Carlo ray optics in a prescribed Gaussian cavity (NVIDIA Warp; CPU by default, CUDA optional); empirical absorption, not a solved keyhole.

label: Materials Database
description: Handbook values and reviewed research references; source applicability requires review.

label: Alloy Builder
description: Composition exploration and inverse design with model-dependent estimates.

label: CALPHAD
description: Phase equilibrium within the selected database and model coverage.

label: TTT / CCT
description: Illustrative steel-only transformation kinetics (TTT/CCT); other alloy classes are unavailable.

label: Micrograph Analysis
description: Image segmentation requires scale calibration and independent inspection.

label: SEM-EDS
description: Spectroscopy and composition characterization with method limitations.

label: Corrosion / EIS
description: Electrochemical measurements, equivalent circuits and model fitting.

label: ICME Multi-Scale Studio
description: Illustrative closed-form property estimates on tabulated constants; no DFT, CALPHAD or FEA is run.

label: Materials Project
description: External computed-material records; connection and coverage may be unavailable.

label: Engineering Calculators
description: Unit-aware engineering correlations within their stated assumptions.

label: Research Hub
description: Research briefs, source comparison, numeric extraction and reviewed registry links.

label: Experimental Data
description: Measured findings, traceability gaps and feedback linked to simulation jobs.

label: Digital Twin
description: Specimen history and module context; completeness does not establish qualification.

label: Uncertainty & Coupons
description: Sampling and uploaded coupon statistics; simulation scatter is not test evidence.

label: Export / Traceability
description: Export active specimen, source provenance and linked evidence as a review package.

label: Research Assistant
description: AI suggestions require source verification before use in engineering decisions.
